category: 光圈 / 景深 (Aperture & Depth of Field)

entries.desc: 不指定光圈或景深傾向，讓模型依焦段、構圖與場景自行決定焦點深度。

entries.en: f/11-style deep focus, broad depth of field, foreground subject and background held readable, crisp scenic detail
entries.desc: 小光圈深焦語言，前景人物與背景資訊都維持可讀，適合希望環境細節清楚的畫面。

entries.en: f/5.6-style balanced depth of field, subject cleanly readable, background gently softened but still recognizable, natural optical separation
entries.desc: 中等景深，主體清楚，背景略柔但仍可辨識，適合人像與環境都要保留的平衡拍法。

entries.en: f/2.8-style shallow depth of field, clear subject plane, soft background defocus, natural portrait separation
entries.desc: 淺景深人像語言，主體焦平面明確，背景柔化並產生自然分離感。

entries.en: f/2.0-style large-aperture portrait depth, strong subject-background separation, creamy optical falloff, softened foreground and background planes
entries.desc: 大光圈人像分離感，背景與前景明顯柔化，主體從空間中浮出。

entries.en: f/1.4-style ultra shallow depth of field, razor-thin focus plane, strong foreground and background defocus, large soft bokeh discs
entries.desc: 超大光圈極淺景深，焦平面非常薄，前後景快速離焦，散景光斑更大且更柔。
